name: How long does it take to build a garage addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a garage addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage addition project varies depending on its complexity, size, and local permitting requirements. Simple additions might take 8-12 weeks from design to completion, while larger or more complex projects, like those involving living space above, can extend to 4-6 months or more. Permitting in cities like Berkeley or Oakland can sometimes extend the initial phase. Weather conditions and material availability can also influence the schedule.
